name: Architecture-Matched Release Rehearsal
summary: Test release-critical architecture-specific builds on genuine matching hardware and exact source before replacing a retired hosted runner or declaring a release gate accepted.
problem: A release matrix may depend on a retiring hosted image; syntax checks or unrelated x86 builds cannot prove Apple Silicon binary freezing and smoke tests will work on its replacement.
coreOutcomes: Release-critical runner matrix and deprecation impact identified
Exact candidate commit pinned for independent architecture-matched rehearsal
Real architecture and OS recorded with binary smoke results and digests
Contributor evidence separated from upstream merge, release workflow and publication
requirements: A source-controlled release matrix and candidate patch
Genuine matching target OS/CPU executor such as Apple Silicon
Native build and smoke commands for the actual release artefacts
A controlled place for logs, artefact digests and provider receipts
boundaries: Cross-architecture emulation alone does not establish a native platform pass
A contributor's separate CI project is not the upstream release workflow
Passing freeze/smoke does not prove every application service is available
A superseded PR is not merged even if the identical change lands elsewhere
Do not publish release binaries or alter customer deployment automatically
